$comment: SSDD per-project config — the injection contract. Seeded as <repo>/.ssdd/config.json by `bin/ssdd.mjs install` (project-owned: updates never overwrite it); fill in the project's routing/rules. All 'paths' / 'include' / 'exclude' values are JS regex sources tested against repo-relative POSIX paths.

routing.$comment: Any route may carry a $comment recording WHY a path is in this lens (e.g. the incident that showed it was missing). The gate ignores it.

reviewGate.$comment: maxRoutedFiles: WARN (not block) when a staged diff touches more routed files than this — the per-task commit rule is being skipped. Docs/ledgers don't count. Default 10. exclude: regexes removed from EVERY route (e.g. ["\\.test\\.tsx?$"]); a route can also carry its own "exclude". stamping: "manual" (default; --stamp attests) or "hooks" (Claude Code: a reviewer subagent's completion stamps its files and the agent cannot run --stamp). Optional reviewerModels (Claude Code only, unset by default — the harness decides): a completion stamp lands only if every turn of the review ran on an allowed model. Entries: "<family>" (any version), "<family>>=<major>.<minor>" (that family at or above), or a substring of the model id; e.g. ["opus>=5.5", "sonnet>=5.5"].

extraRules.$comment: Matches --force (not --force-with-lease / --force-if-includes), bundled short -f, and +refspec — within the push command only (stops at ; & | newline).
extraRules.message: Blocked: force push (--force, -f, or +refspec). Use --force-with-lease, and only after the user's explicit go-ahead.

lint.name: no-hardcoded-hex-colors
lint.message: Hardcoded color — import from the design tokens instead.
